statement: Assume Theorem 2.4. Let the original data lie in the connected horizon class, suppose m > |Q|, and assume equality on the outer branch: ( A ω )(n−2)/(n−1) = m + √ m2 − Q2. (2.21) 7 Then the entire original (Ω, g, K, E), including S, is induced by a global smooth orientation-preserving spacelike embedding into one Reissner–Nordström–Tangherlini exterior (2.20) with parameters (m, Q) and its regular future-horizon extension. The embedding induces precisely the conventions in Definition 2.2; in particular its induced magnetic two-form vanishes. Moreover µm = Jm = 0 throughout Ω. The image lies in the domain of outer communication together with the corresponding future horizon. The boundary maps either to a full smooth section of that horizon, meeting each generator once, or to the bifurcation sphere. The embedding and its future unit normal extend smoothly to S, and the distinguished end approaches the corresponding spatial infinity. No assertion is made behind S, in the extremal case, or for disconnected equality boundaries.
